description:
Bring the web client's hand-written verdict-origin type in line with the served shape, which names the source issue beside the source run.

## Background

The server serves a gate run's `origin` as `{"derivation": "reused", "source_issue": "<issue-id>", "source_run": "<run-id>"}` for a reused verdict. The web client's type `web/src/types/models.ts:46-49` declares `{ derivation: 'reused'; source_run: string }`, and `web/src/components/Issue/IssueDetail.tsx` renders gate runs.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The web client's `GateVerdictOrigin` type carries `source_issue` beside `source_run`, and the web tests, lint and build pass.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the semantic-types epic (2195c98f): issue ids are `IssueId`, gate-run ids `GateRunId`, gate keys `GateKey`, lease ids `LeaseId`, events are an `Event` envelope around a tagged `EventBody`, and record paths come from `VirtualPath` constructors. Line citations name current code, which that epic retypes.
title: The web client types reused-verdict provenance with its source issue
